note: 此刻那一本主线节点原画的场面稿，第二轮之四：主城三幕主线 #1192 到 #1199 余下的十六幕。

nodes.name: 旧战壕
nodes.light: a grey-violet dusk over an old battlefield, with pale cold light on the shapes of ghost soldiers along the trench and one small warm lantern on the ground
nodes.camera: low in the bottom of the trench, close to the squire and the trapped champion, looking along the trench at the standing ghosts; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk in a long-abandoned trench on an old battlefield: crumbling earth walls shored with rotten timbers, rusted helmets and broken pikes half buried, a collapsed bastion on the skyline. All along the trench, at the firing step, stand the pale half-transparent shapes of soldiers of a war long over, in old-fashioned armour, facing outward over the parapet with spears grounded, perfectly still, paying no heed to the living. On the earth wall behind them someone has scratched rows of tally marks and rough lines with a knife, weathered and without readable letters. In the foreground, in the bottom of the trench, a tournament champion sits on the ground against the wall, facing us: a big man of thirty in bright blue and silver jousting armour, dented, his helmet off, his left leg caught under a fallen beam; he is dazed and ashamed, and there is no blood. Kneeling beside him, in full profile facing right toward him, is a young squire of nineteen: gold-red hair cut at the jaw and tied with a leather cord, a grey-white trainee's surcoat worn fuzzy at the elbows, a plain short sword at her hip. Her left hand is braced under the end of the beam, lifting; her right hand is held out to him, open, palm up, to take his arm. She is looking at his legs, not at his face or his crest, and her mouth is open on a short practical question. A small notebook sticks out of the breast of her surcoat. A lantern stands on the ground beside her. Further along the trench two other rescued champions in bright armour sit wrapped in blankets. Drifting ash-like motes and seeds of dry grass float large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：战壕遗迹里被困的选手一个个救出来，塞拉先问还走不走得动，不问排名。墙上那几行他清醒时写的字（卡里只给 AI）画成认不出的刻痕。莱恩哈特没进画。

nodes.name: 枪尖
nodes.light: a dull lightless black round the raised lance in the middle, with a pale cold glow rising from a whole plain of ghosts below, against a blood-orange band of sunset under heavy cloud
nodes.camera: low on the roof of the keep, a wide side view with the squire on the left and the black knight on the right, the plain below and behind them; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: sunset on the flat roof of a ruined keep that stands in the middle of an old battlefield. On a broken turret behind flies a great white banner with a single blue bird-of-prey emblem, stolen and hung there. Beyond the battlements the whole plain, as far as the horizon, is covered with the pale half-transparent shapes of an army of the dead: ranks of foot, lines of horse, and above them ghostly riders on wyverns, wheeling slowly, all of them turned toward the keep, waiting. On the right, in full profile facing left, stands a knight in full black plate armour from head to foot, his helm closed so that no face shows. His right arm holds a long black lance raised straight up above his head, point to the sky, like a commander about to give the signal; the air round the lance is dim, as if it drank the light, and thin grey threads run up from his gauntlet into the shaft. His left hand is pressed against his own breastplate, clawed, as if holding something in. On the left, facing him in full profile facing right, stands a young squire of nineteen: gold-red hair cut at the jaw, a grey-white trainee's surcoat, a plain short sword held out before her in her right hand, pointing at his raised arm; her left hand holds a folded paper against her chest. Her stance is a schoolroom guard, a little too stiff, and she does not give ground. One pace behind her, seen directly from behind, stands the old platinum-bearded grand marshal, tall and very broad, long platinum hair over his shoulders, his great sword still sheathed and both hands resting on its pommel, letting her stand in front. Ash and pale sparks streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：古堡顶上黑甲骑士握着那柄吞人的魔枪，整片旧战场的亡魂都在等枪尖一声令下。头盔不摘。塞拉手里是挑战书的抄本。莱恩哈特让她站在前头是我补的站法（传奇在场不替她打）。

nodes.name: 关门
who: the small halfling cook with curly honey-blonde hair
nodes.light: a warm bar of afternoon sun through the narrowing gap of a great door on the right, against the dusty brown dark of a granary, with a glitter of gold from the swarm
nodes.camera: low on the granary floor, close to the girl at the door, looking along the floor at the split boards and the swarm; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a harvest afternoon inside an enormous royal granary: a timber hall as long as a street, with mountains of grain sacks, a loft, hoists and wooden chutes, festival garlands of wheat ears hung along the beams. In the middle of the floor the boards have split open along a long crack, and up out of it is pouring a swarm of locusts with bodies like beaten gold, each as long as a hand, in a thick glittering column that spreads under the roof; behind them, squeezing up through the crack, comes a rat as big as a pony with a crown-like growth of matted fur. On the right stands the granary's great door, as tall as a house, two thirds closed, a bar of sunlight falling through the gap. Against the edge of that door, in full profile facing right, a farm girl of eighteen is pushing with her whole body: sun-reddened cheeks, a peeling nose, a straw hat with a frayed brim knocked back on its cord, a long-sleeved linen blouse and a long skirt with an apron. Her right shoulder and both her hands are set against the door, her legs are braced and her boots slide on spilled grain; an old blackened sickle is stuck through her belt at the back. Her teeth are set; she is not looking at the swarm at all. In the foreground on the left, facing us and backing toward her, is the small halfling cook with curly honey-blonde hair, in a cream blouse, berry-red vest and long white apron: she holds a heavy iron frying pan in both hands and has just swatted three golden locusts out of the air, her eyes round. Grain dust and bright gold wings streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：蝗群从地板底下涌上来，梅露没跑，先去关粮仓的门。巨型鼠王露半截。地底下那座丰收神殿留到二幕。

nodes.name: 好麦
who: the small halfling cook with curly honey-blonde hair
nodes.light: a warm golden glow from a waterfall of falling grain in the middle, with a brighter sun-like point of light behind it, against the honey-brown shade of an underground hall
nodes.camera: low on the temple floor, close behind the cook, looking up at the girl and the fall of grain above her; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a forgotten temple of the harvest, deep under a granary: a hall of honey-coloured stone with pillars carved as sheaves of wheat, a floor inlaid with suns, and along one side a slow river of amber honey in a stone channel. From an opening high in the vault a waterfall of golden grain pours down without end into a great stone basin, hissing softly, and overflows it in drifts. Behind the falling grain, on an altar, three seeds as large as apples shine like small suns, half hidden. Along the far wall stand ranks of man-shaped figures plaited from straw, motionless, each with a wooden flail. In the middle, standing at the edge of the basin in full profile facing right, is a farm girl of eighteen: sun-reddened cheeks, a peeling nose, a long-sleeved linen blouse and a long skirt with an apron, an old blackened sickle through her belt. She has taken off her straw hat and holds it against her chest with her left hand. Her right hand is stretched out into the edge of the falling grain, palm up, and the kernels are running through her fingers; she is looking at the grain in her palm with the grave attention of someone judging a crop, and her face has gone soft. In the near foreground on the left, seen directly from behind, the small halfling cook with curly honey-blonde hair stands with her head tipped back to look at the top of the fall, in a cream blouse, berry-red vest and long white apron, a ladle in her right hand that drips honey, her left hand on her hip. Kernels of grain and golden dust drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：地底的丰收神殿，谷粒瀑布、稻草魔像阵、蜂蜜河，太阳种子。梅露对着谷粒的瀑布看了半天，说那是好麦。画的是静的一幅。

nodes.name: 报方位
who: the white-haired wood-elf archer in the pale hunter's coat
nodes.light: white lightning from the storm overhead on the left, with a small steady green-gold glow from the instrument on the navigator's wrist and dim blue-green lanterns far ahead in the fog
nodes.camera: from just above the stern rail of a small boat, a little behind the helm, looking forward along the heeling deck at the rocks and the fog ahead; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night at sea in a storm. A small fast cutter with one mast is running hard through steep black waves, heeled far over, spray flying across her deck. All around her, rocks are rising out of the water and sinking again like teeth, black reefs that move, and between two of them a narrow gap of open water lies dead ahead. Far beyond the gap, in a bank of fog, hang the dim blue-green lanterns of a great ghost ship. Off to the right a pirate sloop is cutting in, small dark figures at her rail. Her sail is ragged dark red canvas patched with darker squares of cloth, and the only thing painted on it is one large black jagged shark's fin across the middle; there are no letters, no numbers and no other marks on the sail. At the wheel in the stern of the cutter, on the left, in full profile facing right toward the bow, stands a young woman of twenty-one: short hair stiff with salt and streaming wet, a pencil behind her right ear, a harbour-tower uniform coat washed pale and buttoned to the neck. Her right hand grips a spoke of the wheel; her left arm is raised in front of her face, and on that wrist a small brass navigation instrument with a turning ring glows green-gold. Her eyes are on the instrument, not on the rocks, and her mouth is open, calling out a bearing; her face is calm and exact. Forward of her, at the foot of the mast, in full profile facing right, stands the white-haired wood-elf archer in the pale hunter's coat: chin-length silvery white hair, long pointed ears. She has a long bow fully drawn, the bow held out in her left hand toward the pirate sloop and her right hand drawn back to her cheek, an arrow of pale frost-light on the string. Spray and blown foam streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：海莉驾着快船闯过风暴、海盗的埋伏和会挪动的礁石，报出的方位一个不差，幽灵旗舰在前方的深雾里。

nodes.name: 雾里的嘴
nodes.light: pale blue-green light from the lanterns of the ghost ship and from small lights falling into the fog, against a grey fog just before dawn, with one faint warm streak low on the horizon behind us
nodes.camera: low on the deck of the smaller boat, close behind the navigator, looking across the gap of water at the bow of the ghost ship and beyond it into the fog; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the grey hour before dawn on a sea covered in fog. Several ships run abreast, close together, their yards almost touching: in the foreground the deck of a small cutter, and beside her, across a narrow gap of black water, the high barnacled side and bow of a great ghost ship with ragged pale sails and blue-green lanterns. On the very tip of the ghost ship's bow, in full profile facing right toward the open fog, stands her admiral: a tall drowned-pale man wrapped in an old sea-cloak that trails off into mist, a cocked hat, his right arm stretched straight out ahead, pointing, his left hand behind his back. Ahead of the ships, filling the fog on the right and cut off by the frame, is a beast made of fog itself: the vague shape of a whale-like head as large as a harbour, with a mouth that is only a darker hollow in the mist and rows of pale lights for eyes. From the deck of the ghost ship small soft lights, one after another, are lifting off and drifting forward across the water into that mouth; behind the rail the dim shapes of sailors stand in a line, and one of them has both hands raised to his mouth, shouting. In the near foreground, on the rail of the cutter, a young woman stands seen directly from behind: short salt-stiff hair, a pale harbour-tower uniform coat, a brass instrument glowing on her left wrist. Her right hand grips a rope made fast to the ghost ship's side, her left hand is on a stay, and her knees are bent to swing across. Wisps of fog and blue-green sparks drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：海雾提督阿斯托雷站在回声号的船头，把一整船的船魂献给海雾巨兽，几条船并排开着。船魂画成一盏一盏飘出去的光。海莉只画背影，林薇没进画。

nodes.name: 不骑
nodes.light: a faint cold violet light from seams in walls of black glass, with dim reflections on every side and a small warm glow from the young dragon's eyes
nodes.camera: at shoulder height in the corridor, a little ahead of the girl and the young dragon, looking back at them with their reflections on both sides; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a corridor in a maze built of black glass under a tribunal: floor, walls and ceiling are all polished black, joined by seams that give a faint violet light, and every surface throws back a dark reflection, so that the corridor seems to branch for ever. Coming toward us along it, facing us, walk a girl and a young dragon, side by side. The dragon is a young black wyvern about the size of a horse, bat-winged, one wing folded tight and the other held a little stiffly; its head is lowered and turned toward a side passage on our left, its nostrils wide, its golden eyes glowing warm. The girl walks at its shoulder, not on its back: a dragonkin girl of seventeen with a few dark fine scales at her temples and on the backs of her hands, flying goggles pushed up on her forehead, a short leather riding jacket with old dragon scales sewn on the shoulders over a long-sleeved shirt, long trousers and boots, a small leather pouch on her chest. Her right hand rests flat on the wyvern's neck, following where it turns; her left hand holds the empty reins bundled up, unused. She is looking at the wyvern's eyes and beginning to turn with it. She is unhurt. In the glass wall on our right their reflections walk too, but the girl's reflection is wrong: it has stopped, it faces straight out at us, and one of its hands is pressed against the inside of the glass. Far behind them down the corridor, small, two pairs of red eyes show low to the floor. Violet motes and faint sparks drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：审判庭底下的黑玻璃迷宫，影子照着人的样子长出来，恶魔猎犬在拐角等着。凯娜学着信那头幼龙，不再把它当坐骑使唤。凯娜十七岁，照未成年画。

nodes.name: 骨翼
who: the black-haired presiding judge in black and gold robes
nodes.light: a dull violet fire burning in the joints of a dragon of bones above, darkening the daylight, against a pale grey sky, with glints on black glass roofs
nodes.camera: low on the roof of the tribunal beside its great skylight, close behind the judge, looking steeply up at the bone dragon overhead; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a grey day over a city of black glass and black stone. Above the roof of its great tribunal hangs a dragon made of bones: the skeletons of many dead dragons joined into one enormous Western wyrm, yellowed ribs and spines wired together with threads of dull violet fire that burns in every joint, its wings bare bone with rags of membrane. It fills the sky and is cut off by the frame at the top and on both sides; its wings are spread over the tribunal's shattered skylight and their shadow lies across the whole roof. Inside the cage of its ribs, small and dark, sits a hooded figure in a long robe, hunched over an open book; no face can be seen. Climbing toward the bone dragon from the lower left, small against it, flies a young black wyvern about the size of a horse, bat-winged, and on its back, in full profile facing right, sits a dragonkin girl of seventeen in a short leather riding jacket, goggles down over her eyes, leaning forward along its neck with both hands knotted in the harness, a small leather pouch swinging at her chest. She and the wyvern are unhurt and well clear of the bones. In the near foreground on the roof, seen directly from behind, stands the black-haired presiding judge in black and gold robes: a long straight high ponytail blown to the left, the wide stole flapping. Her right hand holds a gavel raised to the height of her shoulder; her left hand holds up, toward the hooded figure, a single small dark dragon scale between finger and thumb. Chips of bone and violet sparks streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：恶魔术士召出龙骨伪龙，骨翼遮住了审判庭的天窗。术士只画兜帽里的黑影（他是谁页上没点破）。凯娜十七岁，照未成年画，离骨头远。维多利亚手里那片鳞是我补的拿法。

nodes.name: 塔里
nodes.light: pale spring daylight through a tall window on the right, broken by the dark shapes of thorns pressing against the glass, with a dull red pulse deep inside the briars
nodes.camera: inside the round tower room, low, a little to one side of the princess, looking past her at the window and the thorns; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: day in a round room at the top of the highest tower of a royal palace: bare stone walls, on one of which hangs a royal banner showing a gold lion beneath a crown, the crown a plain gold circlet with five tall points each tipped with a round pearl and nothing on top of it, no cross; a narrow bed, a table with an untouched tray, and one tall arched window. Outside the window, pressed against the glass and filling it, are thorn briars as thick as a person's body, dark green and black, with long thorns; they have cracked several panes, and deep among them something pulses with a dull red light, slow as a heartbeat, in the outline of a great closed eye or a sleeping coil. A few thin briars have pushed in through the broken panes and reached across the floor. In the middle of the room, facing the window in full profile facing right, stands a young princess of nineteen: pale gold hair braided and pinned in a circle round her head like a crown, a long white festival gown with long sleeves and a high neck. She stands very straight. Both her hands rest on the pommel of a slender sword whose point is planted on the floor in front of her, and from the place where the point touches the stone a ring of pale rose-gold light has spread across the floor; where the thin briars meet that ring they have stopped and withered. Her chin is lifted and her eyes are fixed on the red pulse outside; her face is tired, composed and entirely her own. Behind her on the left the door of the room stands open on a spiral stair, unguarded, with no lock on it. On the table lies a folded letter with a broken royal seal. Petals blown in through the broken panes and motes of dust drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：公主在塔上压着的是一条跟王室血脉连在一起的龙咒，她是自己登上去的，没人问过她愿不愿意。门开着没锁是画她自己愿意。伊索尔德没进画。小臂上的勒痕叫袖子盖住了。

nodes.name: 偏开一寸
nodes.light: a deep red glow from three crystals beating in the body of the thorn dragon, against a bright sky full of petals, with white light along the sword-captain's blade
nodes.camera: low on the tower's outer stair of briars, close behind the sword-captain, looking steeply up at the dragon wound round the spire; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: day at the top of the highest tower of a royal palace, in a sky full of blowing petals. Round the spire is wound a dragon made of thorn briars: a heavy Western wyrm in shape, its body plaited of dark green briars as thick as tree trunks, its wings frames of thorn hung with thousands of red roses, its jaws a cage of long thorns. It fills the picture and is cut off by the frame at the top and on both sides. In its body three red crystals as large as doors beat like hearts, one in the throat, one in each wing root. In the middle of its chest, half sunk into the briars as into a throne, is a young princess: pale gold hair in a braided circle round her head, a long white gown with long sleeves; the briars hold her from the waist down and her eyes are half open. Her left arm is lost in the thorns, but her right arm is free and bent with effort: her right hand is closed round one great thorny limb of the dragon that crosses in front of her, as thick as her body, and she is pushing it outward and away with all her strength, the limb plainly bent aside, so that a clear gap opens in the briars straight below her. Her face is strained, eyes half open, lips pressed tight; her hand is not raised to the sky and not waving. Up toward that gap, on a rising stair of plaited briars in the near foreground, climbs the rose-gold-haired sword-captain, seen directly from behind: long rose-gold hair pinned with a braided gold crown and streaming, a white and rose-red battle dress with long sleeves and light armour. Her right hand holds a slender sword raised and shining white, pointed at the crystal in the dragon's throat; her left hand grips a briar to pull herself up. Rose petals and splinters of thorn streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：龙咒让安娜贝尔和荆棘龙融到了一起，塔顶的龙晶一下一下地跳。她还醒着的那一半把一根荆棘偏开一寸，给人让出一条路。她身上不画伤。

nodes.name: 空椅
who: the dark-haired night-folk lady in the crimson and black gown
nodes.light: cold silver candlelight along a banquet table, with green wavering light through the water beyond the windows, and one bright point in the mirror at the head of the table
nodes.camera: at table height from the foot of the long table, looking up its length at the host at the head, with the empty chair near us; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a banquet hall in a palace at the bottom of a lake: tall windows with dark green water and drifting weed behind them, chandeliers of silver, and a long table laid with a feast on silver dishes, all of it perfect and untouched. Down both sides of the table sit some twenty guests in the court dress of an older age, upright, hands folded, each turned politely toward the head of the table; and not one of them has a face: under each wig and each coronet is only a smooth pale blank. At the head of the table, facing us, sits the host, a tall figure in the robes and mantle of an ancient king, his own face a smooth blank like polished silver; his right hand holds up a round silver hand-mirror, turned toward us, with a bright point of light in it, and his left hand is extended, palm up, in a gracious gesture toward one empty chair at the near end of the table, pulled out and waiting. Behind that empty chair, facing us, stands the dark-haired night-folk lady in the crimson and black gown: short black hair with a blue sheen and a thin small braid on each side of her face, dark red eyes. Both her hands rest on the back of the chair; she has not sat down, and she looks straight up the table at the host, polite and cold. Beside her on the right, in full profile facing left, a young woman of twenty-three with mist-blue hair in a single damp braid, in a scholar's robe with ink on the cuffs, is leaning toward the nearest faceless guest: her right hand has slipped two fingers into the guest's wide sleeve, and the corner of a heavy seal shows between them. Motes of silver light and tiny bubbles drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：昂瑟兰在宴厅里摆了一桌王宴，满座是没有脸的宾客，请人入座，谁坐下谁的脸就往他的银镜里滑一寸，王印藏在宾客的袖子里。菲尔娜二十三岁。

nodes.name: 镜中队
who: the dark-haired night-folk girl with a thin braid at each cheek
nodes.light: a flat cold silver light pouring out of a huge round mirror on the right, against deep blue-green water-light, with one small dark-red glint in the eyes of the real girl
nodes.camera: a wide side view from low on the floor of the lake-heart, the girl on the left and the mirror on the right; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the heart of a lake, held dry: a round floor of pale stone at the bottom of a great well of standing water, whose walls of green water rise out of sight on every side. On the right half of the picture stands a round mirror as tall as a house in a frame of tarnished silver, cut off by the edge of the frame; its surface gives off a flat cold light. Behind the mirror, half seen above its rim, looms a tall figure in the robes of an ancient king with a smooth blank silver face, both hands resting on the top of the frame. On the left half of the picture, in full profile facing right toward the mirror, stands the dark-haired night-folk girl with a thin braid at each cheek: short black hair with a blue sheen, dark red eyes, fine white skin, a fitted dark battle dress with long sleeves. Her right hand holds a slender blade levelled before her; her left hand is raised with a small dark-red light gathering in the palm. Out of the surface of the mirror, exactly opposite her and in full profile facing left, her own double is stepping: the same hair, the same dress, the same blade and the same raised hand, mirrored left for right, one foot already on the stone and the other still inside the glass; only the double is drained of colour, grey and silver, and its eyes are blank. The points of the two blades are a hand's breadth apart. Deeper in the mirror behind the double, more grey copies wait in a row: a tall woman with a bow, a small figure with a staff. Splinters of silver light and drops of water drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：无面镜王会照抄来者的本事，湖心的镜子里站着另一支一模一样的队伍。分身画成没有颜色、眼睛空白的她。萨薇尔拿的是细剑，立绘上是什么照立绘。

nodes.name: 壳裂
who: the lion-eared war chief with a mane of golden-brown hair and an eyepatch
nodes.light: white lightning in the storm cloud all around, with a warm gold light coming out of a crack in the great egg in the middle, against wet dark timber and ragged sails
nodes.camera: low on the airship's deck, close to the egg and the girl beside it, looking aft along the deck and out into the cloud behind the ship; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the open deck of a pirate airship running through a thunderstorm among floating rocks: wet planks, ragged sails, a gas-bag overhead cut off by the frame, ropes whipping. Amidships, in a cradle of nets and rope, sits an egg as tall as a person, pale and speckled; a crack has run down its shell, and through the crack shines a warm gold light. Crouched beside the egg, facing us, is a beast-eared cat girl of seventeen: grey-and-white cat ears on top of her head, a copper ring in the left ear, a short courier's cape to the waist over a fitted long-sleeved jacket, trousers and laced boots, a folded glider wing of patched canvas strapped to her back. Her left arm is thrown round the egg and her left hand is spread over the crack as if to keep the warmth in; her right hand holds a short knife with which she has just cut one of the cradle's ropes. Her ears are flat against the wind and her eyes are wide; she is looking past us along the deck. She is unhurt. Behind her on the left, swinging in over the rail on a rope with both feet about to land, in full profile facing right, comes the lion-eared war chief with a mane of golden-brown hair and an eyepatch, his right hand high on the rope and his left hand holding a heavy curved blade. Two pirates lie knocked down by the mast, groaning. In the cloud astern of the ship, far behind everyone and cut off by the frame, the head and one wing of a great grey wyvern are just breaking out of the storm, its jaws open, following. Rain, sparks and torn sailcloth streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：穿过雷云、浮石、巨鹰的旧巢，登上空盗的飞艇，一头食鹰飞龙循着蛋里的心跳追上来。琪可十七岁，照未成年画，飞龙离她远。

nodes.name: 石缝
who: the lion-eared war chief with a mane of golden-brown hair and an eyepatch
nodes.light: cold grey storm light on a bare summit, with small blue-white sparks crackling in the down of the eaglet and a break of pale gold in the cloud behind
nodes.camera: low on the rock, close in front of the crevice, looking out past the girl at the war chief and the two who wait beyond him; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the bare top of a mountain in the last of a storm: wet black rock, torn cloud racing past, a break of pale gold light low in the sky. In the foreground on the right a deep crevice splits the rock, and in it, pressed back as far as it can go, sits a newly hatched storm eagle: a chick already as big as a large dog, covered in wet grey down in which small blue-white sparks crackle, with a huge beak and round frightened eyes; pieces of pale speckled shell lie round it. Crouched in front of the crevice, facing us, is a beast-eared cat girl of seventeen: grey-and-white cat ears, a copper ring in the left ear, a short courier's cape, a fitted long-sleeved jacket and trousers. On her back the old glider wing of patched canvas is spread wide, and she holds it out with both hands on its frame like a tent, sheltering the chick from the wind. Her head is turned over her right shoulder toward the open summit; her jaw is set. She is unhurt. In the middle of the summit, with his back to her and to us, seen directly from behind, stands the lion-eared war chief with a mane of golden-brown hair: tall and strong, feet planted, a heavy curved blade held low in his right hand and his left arm stretched out to the side, barring the way. Beyond him two are waiting, apart from each other. On the left, standing on the rock in full profile facing right, an air-pirate captain in a long coat and a feathered hat, a hooked sword on his shoulder. On the right, perched on a crag and cut off by the frame, a great grey wyvern with an old scarred muzzle, its wings half open, its head lowered toward the crevice. Rain and blue-white sparks streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：刚出壳的雏鹰缩在山顶的石缝里，飞龙的首领和空盗的首领一同等在那儿。琪可拿滑翔翼给雏鹰挡风是我补的画面。照未成年画，两边离她远。

nodes.line: 会吃魔法书的黑色幼龙
nodes.name: 星图页
who: the small silver-haired elf mage with two long tails of hair
nodes.light: cool silver-blue starlight from constellations drawn in lines of light on every side, with a warm gold glow from one brass clasp floating ahead, against deep indigo
nodes.camera: low on the bridge of paper, a little behind the two walkers, looking along it into the drawn sky; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: inside a book of star charts that has come alive: there is no ground and no ceiling, only a deep indigo space, and all through it hang constellations drawn as figures in fine lines of silver light joined star to star: a stag, a ship, a tower, a great bird, turning slowly; a brass armillary sphere as big as a house drifts among them. Across this sky runs a bridge made of one long page of cream paper, faintly ruled, curling at its edges; it is the only solid thing. Far behind us the paper of the bridge, and the edges of the sky with it, are going blank and white, as if being rubbed out. Ahead, at the end of the bridge, floats a heavy brass book-clasp with a keyhole, shining warm gold. Along the bridge, walking away from us toward the clasp and seen directly from behind, go two figures side by side. On the right is an apprentice librarian of eighteen in a dark blue apron over a long-sleeved dress, her hair pinned up with a pen: her left arm hugs three books against her chest, and her right hand is stretched out to one side for balance. On her right shoulder sits a black dragon whelp no bigger than a hand, with tiny bat-like wings, facing backward toward us, bright-eyed, the corner of a page in its mouth. On the left, a full head shorter than the librarian, walks the small silver-haired elf mage with two long tails of hair, in a long white coat-robe with a pale mint-green mantle. She has exactly two arms, one on each side of her body: her left arm hangs down on her left side, and her left hand carries her staff upright like a walking stick, its red-jewelled head at the height of her shoulder; her right arm is raised on her right side, one finger pointing up at the constellation of the tower as she walks. No other arm or hand comes from her back. Stars and flecks of silver dust drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：书库深处的书会自己改写，星象书里的天穹，一页一页穿过去收回封面锁，没人去的书架正一排一排变成空白。画的是星图那一本。芙莉莲照立绘标的未成年那一条画。

nodes.line: 会吃魔法书的黑色幼龙
nodes.name: 一片鳞
who: the small silver-haired elf mage with two long tails of hair
nodes.light: a small fierce violet-gold glow round the tiny whelp in the middle, against the glistening black of the ink dragon that fills the night sky, with warm lamp light from the tower windows below
nodes.camera: low on the tower roof, close behind the elf mage, looking up past the little whelp at the huge head above it; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night on the flat roof of the highest tower of a castle library; below, lit windows show shelves of books. Over the roof looms a dragon made of black ink: a heavy Western wyrm as large as the castle, glistening and dripping, its body streaming down the tower walls like spilled ink and rising again into shoulders, a long neck and a huge head, its wings just beginning to open, sheets of black unfolding against the stars. It is cut off by the frame at the top and on both sides. Its head is lowered over the roof, jaws parted. Directly in front of that head, on the top of a stone merlon in the middle of the picture, stands a black dragon whelp no bigger than a hand: its tiny bat-like wings are spread as wide as they will go, its back is arched, its mouth is open in a hiss, and a small fierce glow of violet and gold burns round it. It faces the great head squarely, in full profile facing right; it is not as large as one of the ink dragon's scales. In the near foreground on the left, seen directly from behind, stands the small silver-haired elf mage with two long tails of hair, in a long white coat-robe with a pale mint-green mantle; she holds her staff upright in both hands, and from its head a wide dome of pale light patterned like the petals of a flower is spreading over the roof. On the right, kneeling in full profile facing left toward the whelp, an apprentice librarian of eighteen in a dark blue apron, her hair pinned up with a pen, holds up in both hands three heavy brass book-clasps that shine gold; her mouth is open, calling to it. Drops of ink and violet sparks streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：墨魔借着禁咒化成巨龙伏在塔顶正要展翅，挡在它前面的幼龙个头还没有它一片鳞大。艾薇手里是三枚封面锁。
